lines.trans: What is the most important thing in a waiter's job?
Manners? Politeness?
Spectacular presentation of dishes makes them tastier.
An individual approach?
Right, I am not allowed to have this. This either.
In my opinion, the main thing is patience.
You know what, give me a coffee.
And that is all.
What are you doing? He ordered just coffee!
Coffee? Yes, give me an espresso coffee.
And here, keep the change.
Sometimes patience is very generously rewarded.
